name: Range day at Ashuluk: from cold to two La-17M target drones
description: A live-fire range shoot in the style of Ashuluk, the air-defence range in the Astrakhan steppe (roadmap 10.1). The vehicle stands cold at its firing point; the crew comes to readiness on the range's order and the debrief times it. Then two La-17M target drones are flown at the battery one after the other: the first high and straight in, the second low and to the side, below the search radar's clutter height unless the operator selects СДЦ. The NPC commander runs the crew; take any seat, or his.
notes: The range and the La-17M target follow docs/research/OSA_RESEARCH_2026-10.md section 9 (samsim_thread, ilya_prosto, korovin_tiv_2010). PLACEHOLDERS: the drones' speeds, heights, courses and echoes (range targets often carry reflectors; the size of the echo here is a guess), the time between them, the steppe's height (Ashuluk lies a little below sea level; 0 m here).
